subject.title: fix(teams-meetings): join and transcribe live meetings reliably

question: Should this PR promote live caption capture and the required meetingUrl browser-permission contract for the bundled Teams plugin despite consumer-only live evidence and unverified work-tenant variants?
rationale: The implementation changes a public plugin SDK contract and broadens a user-visible capability; the remaining work-tenant proof boundary cannot be resolved from code review alone.

options.title: Approve after bounded fixes and proof
options.body: Keep the expanded capability, fix the deadline and CLI parity defects, and require redacted consumer proof plus an explicit statement of the work-tenant limitation before merge.

options.title: Narrow the capability claim
options.body: Retain the browser reliability fixes but defer the caption-promotion/docs promise until work-tenant live validation is available.

recommendation.title: Approve after bounded fixes and proof
recommendation.body: Keep the expanded capability, fix the deadline and CLI parity defects, and require redacted consumer proof plus an explicit statement of the work-tenant limitation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged Teams-meetings feature and own the current follow-up’s meeting-runtime and adapter changes.
